I'm not a lefty but the Fair Tax would help everyone.

Brief summary: It's a consumption/sales tax which only taxes new products at the end user level. All imbeded taxes accrued along the way making a product are eliminated. All income, withholding and many other taxes/fees are eliminated. You get 100% of your paycheck each week. You are taxed on the level of spending you choose to do. Again, new products only.

The prebate: this is a mechanism of the tax to help those at the bottom. Every citizen will recieve a specific amount of money in their own private account each month equivalent to 1/12 the amount of money equal to the poverty level. This is a known value published by the US government every year and adjusted for inflation.

This is a revenue neutral tax meaning the final rate would start out based on bringing in the same amount of revenue to the Treasury. One of the biggest savings to most consumers would be the elimination of much of the cost for tax compliance and administration.

This tax also gives the tax payer a better true value of the taxes they pay and makes it harder for politicians to raise taxes.
